title: M21 — Break/fix 01: A Fail-Closed Webhook Wedges Deploys
description: billing-api sits at 0/1 with no Pods. The admission-guard webhook backend is down, and with failurePolicy: Fail the API server rejects every Pod create in tenant-apps — a failed call, not a policy denial. Read the FailedCreate event, distinguish 'failed calling webhook' from 'denied the request', and restore the backend.
